market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Oil at $100 and Iran conflict create upside energy risk but pressure equities via inflation fears. S&P 500 at records with max short interest suggests coiled volatility. Yen carry trade rotation adds FX risk. Apple event and US CPI data are near-term catalysts. Net: range-bound with elevated two-way risk.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive for AI/semis (TSMC, NVDA, ARM) and energy on structural demand. US-China tech decoupling creates bifurcated markets. US fiscal/yield management remains a wildcard. Consumer weakness in retail/dining suggests rotation to value/energy. 6-12 month: favor energy, semis, and defensive quality over consumer discretionary.
